title: Quarterly Financial Report Reauthorization Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary has been expanded because action occurred on the measure.)

Quarterly Financial Report Reauthorization Act

(Sec. 2) Extends the authority of the Department of Commerce to conduct the quarterly financial report program through September 30, 2030, under which Commerce collects and publishes quarterly financial statistics of business operations, organization, practices, management, and relation to other businesses, including data on sales, expenses, assets, liabilities, and other measures of financial condition.

summary.headline: Extends the Commerce Department's authority to collect and publish quarterly financial statistics on businesses through September 30, 2030.
summary.what_it_does: The law lets the Department of Commerce keep running its quarterly financial report program until September 30, 2030. Under the program, Commerce collects and publishes statistics on business operations, including sales, expenses, assets, and liabilities. The summary does not say which businesses must report or how often beyond the quarterly schedule.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses whose financial figures are collected
who_it_affects.how: Their sales, expenses, assets, and liabilities data can continue to be gathered by Commerce through 2030.
They can continue to use the quarterly financial statistics that Commerce publishes through 2030.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The extension took effect when the law was enacted on October 22, 2015, and the program's authority runs through September 30, 2030.
